channel.title: Solar & Geomagnetic Alerts
channel.description: Significant solar flares, filament eruptions, geomagnetic, proton and solar wind alerts.

item.title: Solar wind density: 30.98 p/cm³ (threshold > 20)
item.description: Solar wind density reached 30.98 p/cm³ at 2026-10-30 11:50 UTC (spike began 11:15), beyond the configured threshold (> 20 p/cm³). Latest reading: 17.61 p/cm³.

item.title: WATCH: Sunspot AR4560: beta-gamma-delta magnetic class (Earth-facing, N13W42)
item.description: Level: WATCH. Sunspot region AR4560 is Earth-facing at N13W42 and shows: BGD (beta-gamma-delta) magnetic classification. Sunspot class Eai; area 160 millionths; 20 spots. Based on NOAA's region summary for 2026-10-22 UTC.

item.title: WATCH: Sunspot AR4551: M/X flares already (Earth-facing, S15W59)
item.description: Level: WATCH. Sunspot region AR4551 is Earth-facing at S15W59 and shows: 1 M/X-class flare already reported. Sunspot class Eki; area 350 millionths; 12 spots. Based on NOAA's region summary for 2026-10-19 UTC.

item.title: Coronal hole stream forecast to impact Earth
item.description: SWPC forecast discussion (issued 2026-10-18 00:30 UTC): Active conditions late on 19 Oct are expected to increase to G1 (Minor) geomagnetic storm levels on 20 Oct due to anticipated effects from a positive polarity CH HSS.
